title: Financial expert warms of dangers with "buy now, pay later" options
summary: Local news segment warns that stacking multiple BNPL loans can lead to missed payments and credit-score effects as reporting expands.

assertions.quote: THE INSTANCE OF PEOPLE USING MORE THAN ONE AND IN SOME CASES 2 OR 3 OR MORE HAS RISEN SUBSTANTIALLY
MANY BNPL ARE ADVERTISED AS INTEREST FREE, BUT IF YOU MISS A PAYMENT, YOU COULD FACE LATE FEES
MAKE YOUR PAYMENTS ON TIME, AND YOUR CREDIT SCORE COULD IMPROVE. MISS A PAYMENT AND IT COULD DAMAGE YOUR SCORE.
WHILE IT CAN BE A USEFUL BUDGETING TOOL, TREATING IT LIKE FREE MONEY CAN QUICKLY BECOME AN EXPENSIVE MISTAKE
